verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents three ways to provision GPU instances: the console search page for finding machines and creating instances, a full REST API with a live OpenAPI spec, and an official CLI/SDK. The CLI hello-world walks through search, rent, wait for boot, connect and run commands over SSH, and the docs claim one-click templates and spin-up 'in seconds'. Community reports of host variability and extra hoops compared with AWS/GCP add friction but do not contradict fast provisioning. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the provisioning-to-running-code time, evidence that on-demand host reliability is consistent.
